title: [Bug]: `SWIGLUOAI_UNINTERLEAVE requires clamp_limit` blocks MiniMax-M3 AWQ/GPTQ INT4
author: meffmadd

comments.author: rathodkunj2005
comments.body: I traced this to the WNA16 quant-config path: `CompressedTensorsWNA16MarlinMoEMethod` builds its `FusedMoEQuantConfig` without the layer's `swiglu_alpha`, `swiglu_beta`, or `swiglu_limit`, and the int4 W4A16 config currently has no fields for them. Marlin therefore receives `clamp_limit=None` even though the model config specifies 7.0. I'm working on a scoped INT4 fix with a regression test.

comments.author: rathodkunj2005
comments.body:
The scoped patch is ready here: https://github.com/rathodkunj2005/vllm/compare/main...fix/wna16-int4-swiglu-config

The GPU-free regression test and pre-commit suite pass. I don't have compatible NVIDIA model hardware locally, so before opening the PR, could you confirm that one of the affected W4A16 checkpoints now gets through engine warmup? The patch only threads the existing `swiglu_alpha`, `swiglu_beta`, and `swiglu_limit` values into the INT4 `FusedMoEQuantConfig`.
